Sasha (SRE): Noticed elevated TLS handshake failures from ap-southeast-1 model-serving cluster starting ~03:00 UTC. Clients report connection errors and intermittent 502s.

DevOpsBot: [ALERT] TLS handshake failure rate > 10% on model-serve-apac. Incident auto-created: INC-2024-044. Paging oncall.

Priya (SWE): I'm seeing cert verify failures in the model sidecar logs: "x509: certificate has expired or is not yet valid". Looks like certs on the serving nodes expired unexpectedly.

Ravi (Networking): Confirmed. LB healthchecks started failing at 02:58 and several pods restarted due to sidecar crashes. Traces show TLS negotiation stopped after cert chain validation errors.

Maya (Customer Success): Support queue lighting up — a few customers in APAC seeing failures for embedding & generation calls. Triage priority high.

Sasha (SRE): Immediate mitigations: 1) disabled strict cert validation on LB for internal healthcheck path to avoid cascading restarts, 2) reissued and rolled certs for the model-serving sidecars, 3) temporarily routed new traffic from ap-southeast-1 to us-east-1 for critical customer namespaces. Commands used:
```
# reissue certs
kubectl -n model-serving exec cert-manager -- /bin/recreate-certs.sh --cluster ap-south-east
# rollout restart to pick new certs
kubectl -n model-serving rollout restart deployment model-sidecar
# update routing for critical namespaces
kubectl -n routing patch configmap region-routing -p '{"data":{"apac-fallback":"us-east-1"}}'
```

Priya (SWE): Certs rolled and sidecars restarted. Validation done: new cert expiration set to 2026-09-01. Healthchecks recovered within ~6 minutes after restart.

Ravi (Networking): Traffic reroute applied for critical namespaces only. Will keep regional routing in fallback state until we finish verification and sync cert automation.

SupportBot: Posted customer update draft to incident doc: https://docs.internal.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-2024-044/comms-draft.md — waiting CS review.

StatusPage Bot: Posted initial status: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-2024-044 1: Partial outage impacting ap-southeast-1 model endpoints.

Maya (Customer Success): Sent targeted message to impacted customers with ETA and mitigation steps. Will update once we clear monitoring window.

Sasha (SRE): Current status: mitigated for most traffic — handoffs to fallback region are stable and error rates dropped to baseline for >15min. Keeping channel open for 60 minutes monitoring.

Priya (SWE): Follow-ups: 1) postmortem with root cause (failed cert auto-rotation job), 2) add alert when cert expiry < 14 days, 3) remove manual fallback after cert automation verified, 4) fix cert-rotation job to be robust to transient API rate limits. I'll own the patch.

Sasha (SRE): Marking incident as resolved for now, monitoring window active. If anyone sees regression, ping @oncall immediately. :white_check_mark:
